problem: Replacing the native XLSB hyperlink with an invalid range removed its old relationship before validating the replacement. The call returned an error, but the same edit then failed to read its staged hyperlink with InvalidRelationship: a hyperlink names a missing relationship. String encoding could fail after relationship insertion/removal as well. Native calculation, cache lifecycle, view and protection operation scopes also remained unmapped or untested.
changes: Run XLSB hyperlink add, set and remove operations on a cloned candidate edit. Publish that candidate back to the edit only after every relationship, record encoding and worksheet replacement step succeeds. Earlier staged edits and original source ownership survive errors.
Add two XLS native calculation/view regressions and six XLSB native calculation-chain, hyperlink and protection regressions.
Qualify ten native XLSB Calculation Chain parts for opaque inventory, exact no-op, removal and reopened member inverse; keep record counting an explicit non-normative diagnostic.

Bind the existing XLS macro-sheet catalog/readback tests to xls-138 after inspecting their actual directory assertions and rerunning them. Update native fixture/test accounting and existing feature notes without changing the historical corpus authoring inventory.

verification_scope.xls_calculation: Four native workbooks retain full precision, enabled automatic threading, per-sheet automatic mode, 100 iterations, delta 0.001, A1 references and recalculate-before-save. Iteration, pending recalculation and force-full flags are absent. RecalcId engine IDs are 967461 for values/formulas and interaction/print, and 977461 for metadata and date1904; independent CFB record inspection confirmed payloads c101000025c30e00 and c101000035ea0e00.
verification_scope.xls_views: Exact saved tab IDs, window geometry, scroll/tab flags, first visible tab, selected count and 600-per-mille tab ratio are asserted. The values fixture has tab IDs [2,1,3], active complete tab 2 (Sheet2) and active ordinary-worksheet ordinal 1; Sheet1 has all four frozen-pane selections around B2. Metadata selects Print_015 (tab 4); the date1904 specimen selects B6.
verification_scope.xls_publication: Existing native Sheet1 B2 is changed to 123 with set_numeric, preserving its BIFF storage family. Save/reopen leaves every other cell value/formula, calculation/view model, selected raw calculation/window/pane/selection record and other CFB stream unchanged. Inverse restores exact source bytes.
verification_scope.xlsb_calculation: Four native 26-byte BrtCalcProp records retain calcId 181029, automatic mode, 100 iterations, delta 0.001, stored thread count 8 and exactly A1/FULL_PRECISION/RECALC_ON_SAVE/MTR bits. USER_THREADS is unset, so the stored count is not asserted as an execution setting. Typed encoding reproduces the native payload exactly.
verification_scope.calculation_chain: Ten native parts range from 21 to 1701 bytes and have explicit SHA-256/part-name/content-type expectations and 3 to 115 generic record envelopes. Removal is idempotent when already staged, deletes only the chain plus its workbook relationship/content-type entries, preserves all other package member bytes and saved calculation properties, and reopens with exact-member inverse restoration. No chain record cell/dependency grammar is inferred.
verification_scope.chain_budget: The 246-byte, 18-record values/formulas chain remains readable/removable as opaque data under a 17-record diagnostic ceiling. record_count returns the typed CalculationChain Records limit; the diagnostic failure does not block removal or exact retained-owner inverse.
verification_scope.hyperlink_reads_and_protection: Native A10 uses rId2, target https://example.com/litchi-excel-fixture and tooltip Native hyperlink screen tip 002; display/location fields are absent. Family and source-backed selected-feature inventories agree. Sheet protection is locked with no password hash/strong verifier; selecting locked/unlocked cells, sort and filter are allowed, while the other stored permissions are false.
verification_scope.hyperlink_lifecycle: Retarget A10 and its tooltip, add an internal B10 link and remove both through the low-level metadata owner. Only sheet1.bin and its relationship member change. Complete non-hyperlink record bytes, including their encoded headers, remain exact. Unrelated relationship attributes remain identical; no ghost external relationship appears. Reopened inverse restores every original member; retained-owner removal inverse restores its exact prior artifact.
verification_scope.failure_atomicity: An inverted native range returns exact InvalidFormat and leaves a readable edit with a byte-exact no-op commit. After a valid internal-link addition, external add/set operations exceeding a 256 UTF-16-unit budget with 257 units return typed StringLimit and preserve the previously staged artifact. Missing-index removal likewise leaves it unchanged. This covers failures before and after relationship mutation would previously have occurred.
verification_scope.accounting: Six previously unasserted operation rows gain new native tests: xls-144, xls-145, xlsb-285, xlsb-288, xlsb-296 and xlsb-305. xls-138 gains previously missing mappings to two existing native macro-catalog tests. All seven remain partial, not complete-feature claims.
verification_scope.limits: No fresh Excel reopen, view rendering, formula recalculation, calculation threads, hyperlink navigation or external refresh occurred. Calculation settings/view mutation and typed Calculation Chain payload editing remain outside these assertions. Hyperlink editing preserves protection records but does not enforce native Excel UI permissions; protection is not a cryptographic boundary. Reopened hyperlink inverse preserves member bytes, not original ZIP serialization. Strong sheet-verifier behavior is not qualified by these passwordless fixtures.
